name: Reedwell Trap
description: A collapsible woven fish trap of waxed Thornfiber and supple Silverbark Ash ribs, set among reeds and quiet water along basin margins, marsh edges, and slow streams. Funnel-mouthed and weighted at the base, it gathers fish into the holding cone passively while the setter tends to other work — the standard fieldcraft for marsh-edge fishing across the Feywood, far better suited to wet basin terrain than active casting from shore.
narrative_effects: Provides passive marsh-edge and reed-bed fishing without occupying the setter's hands or attention.
Collapses for travel; deploys cleanly at any reedy water edge with a few minutes of setup.
Yields modest reliable catch in suitable terrain over a watch or rest period; supports survival rolls for sustained camp food in wet basin and marsh regions.
Standard fieldcraft for elven foragers and Heartwarden patrol cooks.
